verdict.rationale: Rippling's docs say its federated identity handles OIDC, SAML, LDAP, AD, RADIUS and custom SCIM/SAML apps, so SSO protocol support is evidenced. Nothing in the pack describes a pre-built SSO app catalog, how big it is, or how quickly integrations connect. Missing for 10: evidence of a pre-built SAML/OIDC app catalog, catalog size (thousands of apps), minutes-to-connect setup, independent or hands-on corroboration.
